title: activitypub/http_sign.rs: RsaPrivateKey cloned on every sign_post call
description:
Why this issue exists: In crates/mail/src/activitypub/http_sign.rs, RsaActorKey::sign_post constructs a new SigningKey by cloning the entire RsaPrivateKey on every call. RSA private keys are large; this is an unnecessary allocation per outbound ActivityPub delivery.

What needs to be done: Construct the SigningKey once and store it alongside or instead of the raw RsaPrivateKey in RsaActorKey, so sign_post borrows without cloning.
